notes: A menu rail on the left replaces the bottom tabs. Performance is now its own page with METAR, TAF, Send to MCDU and recent calculations.
Every flight has a Report tab: the condition of each part before and after, and what aged or broke.
Help has a start-here page, tasks, a guide and a glossary. Optional: the airline can use the aircraft while you are away.
Fairer scoring: one landing penalty, warm-up and cool-down scored once per flight, a clearer overspeed rule. Landing damage is stronger. Icing is removed.
TechLog asks Fenix less often, and a click in its window can no longer freeze the flight recording.
